job.title: Junior MLOps Engineer
job.description: ScaleAI Labs (Pune) needs a Junior MLOps Engineer to bridge the gap between machine learning research and reliable production pipelines. Key skills: MLflow, Docker, FastAPI model serving, Triton or vLLM, GitHub Actions CI/CD for models, and monitoring.

pool.text: MLflow: tracked experiment runs, registered model versions, and packaged artifacts
FastAPI Model Serving: wrapped PyTorch and Scikit-learn models into high-concurrency inference endpoints
Docker Containerization: crafted GPU-enabled Docker containers with CUDA drivers and optimized layers
Model Monitoring: instrumented Prometheus metrics for model latency, throughput, and prediction drift
MLOpsDeployPipeline: automated GitHub Actions workflow retraining and deploying models upon new data commit
B.E. Computer Science, Pune Institute of Computer Technology (PICT), 2022–2026, CGPA 8.8/10
vLLM & Triton Inference Server: set up optimized inference servers with continuous batching and KV caching
CSS Tailwind styling: created personal blog website
MLOps Intern at DataPipe (Pune, 3 months): configured MLflow registry and automated staging deployments
Linux & Bash scripting: automated dataset sync from AWS S3 to local training server
UI Design: designed icons for college mobile app
Data Drift Detection: computed Population Stability Index (PSI) and Evidently AI reports
